anchor: On the language pool the same forecast passes bursts under realistic replica leads only through the tail-aware capacity conversion --- a measured belief-to-knee ratio, tested under a held forecast cursor rather than a second anticipation test --- which repairs the mean-based sizing defect shared by every reactive configuration tested.
claim_text: Language pool: forecast passes bursts via tail-aware conversion (belief-to-knee ratio) under held cursor; fixes mean-sizing defect.
